settings.name_in_paper: Online conformal prediction beyond feedback / OCPWF partial monitoring game
unmapped: Actions are |M| conformal thresholds plus a query action; threshold actions give no observation, the query action yields zero reward but reveals the label (hence the reward of every threshold)
Auxiliary reward R(m,t) = 1 - m(1-beta) if y_t in Gamma_C(x_t,m), else 0; coverage guarantees derived from regret
Inputs x_t observed each round; regret against best fixed threshold
settings.definition_quote: On each round, the learner may either deploy a prediction set or query the correct label, but not both. ... We reduce this problem to a partial monitoring game in which prediction actions return no observation and a separate query action reveals the label.

algorithms.name: OCPQ (OCP With Queries, label-efficient exponentially weighted forecaster)

symbols.eps_q: query probability epsilon of the algorithm

source.label: thm:simple_learner_regret
source.quote: For any data stream $z^T$ and classifier $C$, and any $\eta \in (0,1]$ and $\epsilon \in (0,0.5]$, the expected regret of Algorithm~\ref{algorithm:OCP_with_queries} is at most $\frac{\ln(|M|)}{\eta} + \epsilon \cdot T + \left(\frac{\eta}{\epsilon}\right) \cdot T$.

results.notes: Regret w.r.t. auxiliary reward; restated as Theorem 5 in appendix.

conditions: T^{-1/3} <= 0.5 and T^{-2/3} sqrt(ln|M|) <= 1 (implicit from parameter ranges)

source.label: thm:simple_learner_regret
source.quote: If we set $\epsilon = T^{-1/3}$ and $\eta = T^{-2/3} \cdot \sqrt{\ln(|M|)}$ then this simplifies to $T^{2/3} \cdot (2 \sqrt{\ln(|M|)} + 1)$.

results.notes: Expected query fraction T^{-1/3}. Appendix Theorem 10 recovers this for fixed q_t; doubling-trick anytime variant (2.71 factor) discussed informally.

conditions: eta = T^{-2/3} sqrt(ln|M|) <= 1 and epsilon = T^{-1/3} <= 0.5

source.label: corollary:coverage_rate_bound
source.quote: On any data stream $z^T$ and for any classifier $C$, the coverage rate of Algorithm~\ref{algorithm:OCP_with_queries} satisfies $\mathbb{E}\left[p_{\text{cover}}\right] \geq \beta - \left(\frac{2 \sqrt{\ln(|M|)} + 1}{\sqrt[3]{T}}\right)$ if $\eta = T^{-2/3} \cdot \sqrt{\ln|M|} \leq 1$ and $\epsilon = T^{-1/3} \leq 0.5$.

results.notes: Expression is the coverage deficit beta - E[p_cover]. Derived from Theorem 2 (pathwise: coverage >= beta - reg/T). Restated as Corollary 3 / Corollary 6.

source.label: thm:high_probability_bound
source.quote: For any $\delta \in (0,1)$, if $\epsilon = T^{-1/3} \leq 0.5$ and $\eta = T^{-2/3} \cdot \sqrt{\ln(|M|)} \leq 1$, then with probability at least $1-\delta$, the regret of Algorithm~\ref{algorithm:OCP_with_queries} is at most ...

For any $\epsilon \in (0,0.5]$, $\eta \in (0,1]$, and $\delta \in (0,1)$, we have that the regret of Algorithm~\ref{algorithm:OCP_with_queries} is at most $2\left(\frac{n}{\epsilon}\right) + \epsilon T + \eta T + \left(\frac{\eta}{\epsilon}\right)T + \left(\frac{\eta}{\epsilon^2}\right)n + \frac{\ln(|M|)}{\eta}$ with probability at least $1-\delta$, where $n = 2\sqrt{\epsilon T\ln(3/\delta)} + 2\ln(3/\delta)$.

If $\epsilon = T^{-1/3} \leq 0.5$ and $\eta = T^{-2/3} \cdot \sqrt{\ln(|M|)} \leq 1$, then for any $\delta \in (0, 1)$ we have that with probability at least $1-\delta$, the coverage rate $p_\text{cover}$ of Algorithm~\ref{algorithm:OCP_with_queries} is at least ...

results.notes: Expression is the coverage deficit beta - p_cover, holding w.p. >= 1-delta. Restated as Corollary 4.

symbols.clip_err: E[max(2 sigma - theta_k^* - 1, 0)], clipping error term

conditions: k >= 2 periods with n_i = n_1 2^{i-2} for i >= 2
each period long enough that eta_i <= 1 and epsilon_i <= 0.5
tuning: beta_1 = sigma, beta_i = clip(2 sigma - theta_i^*)

source.label: thm:adaptive_ocpq_coverage_bound
source.quote: Suppose that we run the adaptive version of \texttt{OCPQ} with target coverage $\sigma \in [0,1]$ over $k \geq 2$ time periods ... We then have that $\mathbb{E}[p_{cover}] \geq \sigma - \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{2/3}\cdot\left(\frac{2\sqrt{\ln(|M|)} + 1}{\sqrt[3]{T}}\right) - \frac{1}{2} \cdot \mathbb{E}\left[\max\left(2\sigma -\theta_{k}^\star - 1, 0\right)\right]$.

results.notes: Expression is the coverage deficit sigma - E[p_cover]. General period-length version in Theorem 8; clipping term bounded in Theorem 9/Corollary 5 (not recorded).

conditions: beta < 1 (if beta = 1, zero regret is achievable)

source.label: prop:OCPPF_is_a_hard_game
source.quote: The optimal worst-case expected regret in OCPWF is $\Theta(T^{2/3})$, unless $\beta = 1$, in which case we get 0 regret by picking $a_t = 1$ every round.

results.notes: Minimax rate via Lattimore & Szepesvari classification: game is globally but not locally observable. Recorded as the lower-bound side of the Theta statement.

symbols.sum_q: E[sum_t q_t], expected total query probability

source.quote: For any data stream $\xi$ and classifier $C$, any $\eta\in(0,1]$, and any predictable sequence of query probabilities $q_t\in(0,0.5]$, the expected regret of Algorithm~\ref{algorithm:OCP_with_queries} with the auxiliary reward is at most $\frac{\ln(|M|)}{\eta} +\mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t=1}^Tq_t\right] +\eta\,\mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t=1}^T\frac{1}{q_t}\right]$.

results.notes: Adaptive query-rate variant of OCPQ; reduces to Theorem 1 for fixed q_t. Corollary 7 shows fixed rate minimizes this bound for a given budget.
